update_empty_version: Error of `atlas update` when GitHub answers with an empty version tag. Rare: a broken release feed.
update_failed: Line printed after the red error prefix when the self-update that runs before a command (or the background one) fails. {error} is the reason, English or not.
update_older_release_managed: Error from atlas update when it would roll back to an older release but a package manager (Homebrew, a distro package) owns this Atlas, so only that tool can install it.
update_restart_failed: Line printed after the red error prefix when atlas updated itself but could not start the new version. {error} is the reason.
